issues: P1 — Preflight verification runs outside the preservation and attribution window. In Master.execute_phase, check_phase(phase, preflight) executes before creating the phase entry inventory and before any pre-edit preservation or capture_phase_changes call. A checker that accidentally overwrites or deletes an editable manuscript file can therefore alter the baseline subsequently preserved for a new phase. On resume, preflight changes likewise fall outside the recorded work window. check_protection protects frozen evidence, but does not restore or attribute ordinary editable files. Repair: preserve and persist the entry inventory before preflight; wrap preflight in its own preserved before-snapshot and finally-based contribution capture; enforce deletion obligations and pass its changes to subsequent planning and review. Alternatively, enforce and verify a strictly read-only preflight with prior-byte preservation. Add regression coverage for preflight overwrite, deletion and failure after a write.

P2 — Partial-continuation freshness omits declared verification inputs. Master.save_continuation hashes contributed files, the test file and deliverables, but does not include checked['input_hashes']. In contrast, save_pending_review includes those inputs. phase_recovery then labels a continuation 'checked_snapshot_not_acceptance' solely from the incomplete evidence_hashes map. Changing a declared research or other checker input that is neither a contribution nor a deliverable leaves that label unchanged and supplies the next plan with stale checked-snapshot guidance. Repair: include declared check inputs in the continuation fingerprint and compare their current hashes with the values recorded by verification; record changed or missing inputs as requiring recheck. Bind the saved check record as well. Add a regression where only a declared checker input changes between partial work and recovery.
next_actions: Move preflight into the preservation and contribution-accounting boundary.
Make partial-continuation freshness cover verification inputs and the saved check record.
Run focused regressions for these cases, then rerun controller verification and a fresh bounded review.
residuals: Process cleanup, exclusive locking and reusable narrow command approval cannot be independently certified from the implementations supplied in this packet.
A stale partial continuation does not itself grant acceptance: the supplied execution path reruns checks. The second finding concerns accurate recovery and fresh-plan inputs.
